preconditions.description: The dimensions of the picture and the number of copies must be within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: len(pictures) == k + 1 and all(len(picture) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in picture) for picture in pictures)
preconditions.description: The number of pictures must match k+1, and each picture must have the correct dimensions.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in '01' for c in row) for picture in pictures for row in picture)
preconditions.description: All characters in the pictures must be either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.description: The output must start with the index of the initial picture.
The number of operations must match the count of operations listed.

postconditions.expression: all(operation.startswith('1') or operation.startswith('2') for operation in operations)
postconditions.description: Each operation must be either a recolor or a copy operation.
